title: Separate fixed-vector convergence from compact-family control
obstacle: Pointwise/fixed-vector convergence is being used as a uniform operator estimate.
procedure: Prove uniform local bounds and an equicontinuity/derivative estimate.
Build a finite-net or compact-subsequence statement in the actual target topology.
Combine it with uniqueness/identification and tail control to reach the required uniform conclusion.
verification: Check every varying parameter and sequence and preserve the unit-ball quantifier.
positive_example: BO N5 uses uniform Lipschitz bounds and a finite grid before diagonal local convergence.
negative_example: Convergence for each fixed q does not imply convergence uniformly over the unit ball.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.
